description: Enemies balancing domain (D-10). HP/DMG values, when they land, use the prototype's x10 combat scale (D-12). Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.

_lock.description: Branch+lock protocol state (D-11): the literal string UNLOCKED, or {locked_by, since} while a feature<Domain> branch exists. Set by /start-domain and cleared ONLY by /merge-domain (Phase 8, T-1) - never by the editor.

hp_multiplier.description: Unitless multiplier on enemy max HP (HP is x10 combat scale, D-12). Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.

speed_multiplier.description: Unitless multiplier on enemy movement speed (base rates in tiles/second land in Phase 9). Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.
